lookback_source.quote: Days - record the number of days this therapy was administered for at least 15 minutes a day in the last 7 days

lookback_notes: The item form and coding instructions both specify the last 7 days as the observation window; the example on the same page refers to it as the "7-day look-back period." The document does not state on this page how the 7 days are counted relative to the ARD.

coding_levels.label: Days respiratory therapy was administered for at least 15 minutes a day in the last 7 days
coding_levels.definition: Enter the number of days therapy services were provided in the last 7 days; a day of therapy is defined as treatment for 15 minutes or more in the day.

coding_levels.label: Zero days

federal_coding_rules.rule: Days on which therapy totaled less than 15 minutes are not counted; the example shows 10 minutes/day on 5 days (50 total minutes) coded as 0 days.

source.quote: Although a total of 50 minutes of respiratory therapy services were provided over the 7-day look-back period, there were not any days that respiratory therapy was provided for 15 minutes or more. Therefore, O0400D equals zero days.
